request.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: four painted source KEY POSES for a 2D game walk, not a finished atlas.

Create ONE transparent 2 by 2 sheet showing the SAME mature woman HEIKE HOFFMANN in FOUR successive poses of a calm RIGHTWARD walking cycle. EVERY figure faces SCREEN RIGHT in strict SIDE PROFILE. Each complete figure occupies its own equally sized quadrant with generous transparent gutters and all hair, fingers, keys and shoes inside its cell. No labels, text, lines, background, floor or ground shadow. The reference image is the binding adult identity and prop ownership, not a request to repeat its wide stride or patterned cloth.

LOCK IDENTITY in every cell: grown adult stature and long connected limbs, silver-grey bob, red-brown glasses, pearl earring, angular tired older face, closed fine resting lip line, burgundy knitted cardigan over cream floral-collar blouse, full-length charcoal trousers, substantial worn brown LACE-UP OXFORD shoes. Her NEAR anatomical RIGHT arm hangs beside the hip and its ONE hand carries ONE key ring. Her FAR anatomical LEFT hand carries the green/blue/yellow cards in front of her chest. Keep those arms, hands and props consistent in all four cells; no swaps, extra hands, extra keys, missing cards, changes of grip or separate floating props. Natural far-arm occlusion is correct. Keep her original head, torso, hip, thigh and shin proportions. She walks upright and deliberately, not crouched, waddling or exaggeratedly marching. Modest normal stride, connected waist/seat/thigh/knee/cuff/ankle/shoe anatomy, complete feet.

ORDER OF FOUR CELLS, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom:
TOP LEFT: contact A. The NEAR RIGHT leg steps FORWARD to screen right, heel just planted, knee relaxed. The FAR LEFT leg trails to screen left, heel raised and toe still touching the same floor line. This is a modest walk step, not a wide lunge.
TOP RIGHT: passing A. The NEAR RIGHT leg is planted nearly vertical under the hip, bearing weight. The FAR LEFT knee swings FORWARD across the body, with its shoe lifted a little clear of the floor. The far thigh/shin may be occluded naturally by the near leg; retain the correct two legs and one shoe for each. Pelvis/head slightly higher than contact, no squat or twisted knees.
BOTTOM LEFT: contact B, the OPPOSITE contact, NOT a copy of top left. The FAR LEFT leg now leads FORWARD to screen right with its heel planted. The NEAR RIGHT leg trails to screen left with its heel raised and toe touching the floor. Keep the same fixed near RIGHT versus far LEFT depth ownership; do not mirror the body, swap props or redraw her facing left.
BOTTOM RIGHT: passing B. The FAR LEFT leg is planted nearly vertical under the hip, bearing weight. The NEAR RIGHT knee swings FORWARD, its own Oxford lifted slightly off the floor. This is the opposite passing pose, not the same planted leg as top right. Keep natural occlusion and intact knees/cuffs/shoes, not crossed rubber shins or one fused two-headed foot.

All four are the same physical size and camera projection, anchored on the SAME relative horizontal floor level in their equally sized cells. Natural small vertical pelvis/head rise at passing is intentional. Do not resize each pose to equal crown-to-sole height or vary head/limb lengths to fit a cell. Keep camera distance and adult body scale identical.

Paint this further toward DISCO ELYSIUM MEETS BERLIN: angular expressive worn face, broad irregular scumbled dry-brush oil paint, subdued wine/charcoal/dirty ochre/cool grey-green shadows, lived-in heavy cloth, believable shoes. REPLACE the reference's repeating diamonds with PLAIN maroon knit and PLAIN charcoal cloth, defined by large irregular brush marks and a few real garment folds. Absolutely no repeated diamond, argyle, polygon tiling, check pattern or decorative faceting on cardigan or trousers. Not glossy 3D, cute, smooth plastic, photorealistic skin or a grain filter. Preserve the small floral blouse collar only. Actual alpha-zero transparent background everywhere outside the four figures; no coloured vignette, halo or scenery. Four poses only, no fifth figure.

status: UNSELECTED HELD: repeated leading/stance leg and repeating diamond cloth; no four-key gait acceptance
